ingredients.name: Hoisin sauce
ingredients.watch: Check the label for oyster or shrimp extract. Most hoisin has none.

ingredients.name: Tamari
ingredients.watch: Check the label: most tamari is gluten-free, but not every brand.

ingredients.name: Flour tortillas (8-inch)
ingredients.watch: Check the label for lard. Most store brands use oil or vegetable shortening instead.

ingredients.name: Corn tortillas (6-inch)
ingredients.watch: Check the label for lard. Most store brands don't use it.

ingredients.name: Sour cream
ingredients.watch: Check the label for gelatin. Pick a brand made without it.

ingredients.name: Small-curd cottage cheese
ingredients.watch: Check the label for gelatin. Pick a brand made without it.

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin steak, about 1 inch thick
Plain Greek yogurt
ingredients.watch: Check the label for gelatin. Pick a brand made without it.

ingredients.name: Vegetarian refried beans
ingredients.watch: Many refried beans are made with lard. Buy a can marked vegetarian, and check the label.

ingredients.name: Bulk turkey breakfast sausage (no casing)
ingredients.watch: Buy bulk turkey sausage, sold loose with no casing. Links often use pork casings, even when the meat is turkey.

ingredients.name: Burrito-size flour tortillas (10-inch)
ingredients.watch: Check the label for lard. Most store brands use oil or vegetable shortening instead.

ingredients.name: Gluten-free tortillas
ingredients.watch: Check the label for lard. Most store brands use oil or vegetable shortening instead.

ingredients.name: Turkey bacon
ingredients.watch: Pick a package that says fully cooked.

ingredients.name: Smoked chicken andouille sausage (fully cooked)
ingredients.watch: Buy chicken andouille that's collagen-cased or skinless. Many chicken sausages are stuffed into pork casings, and some mix in pork, so read the whole label. Beef kielbasa works too, with the same checks.

ingredients.name: Beef kielbasa (fully cooked)
ingredients.watch: Buy kielbasa labeled all beef, collagen-cased or skinless. Most kielbasa is pork, and many beef ones still use pork casings, so read the whole label.

ingredients.name: Thin wheat noodles (Shanghai or plain lo mein)
ingredients.watch: Check the label: some fresh noodles have egg. Either kind works.

ingredients.name: Roasted seaweed sheets (nori, for kimbap or sushi)
ingredients.watch: Buy plain sheets. Seasoned snack packs can have fish flavoring.
Check the label for lard. Most bakery rolls use oil or shortening.
ingredients.name: Bolillo rolls (or small French rolls)

ingredients.watch: Buy a plain or lemon-herb chicken. Check the label: no bacon or ham in the seasoning.
ingredients.name: Rotisserie chicken

ingredients.watch: Check the label: anchovies, salt, and sugar only. Some brands add shrimp or squid; skip those.
ingredients.name: Fish sauce

ingredients.watch: Check the label: most are rice, chili, soybeans, and salt. Skip any with shrimp or squid.
ingredients.name: Gochujang (Korean chili paste)
Tostada shells
ingredients.watch: Check the label: some tostada shells are fried in lard. Most brands use vegetable oil, and baked ones use none.

ingredients.name: Frozen shelled edamame or baby lima beans
Beef salami
ingredients.watch: Check the label: all beef, in a collagen or cellulose casing. Many salami casings are pork, even on beef salami.

ingredients.name: Bresaola (air-dried beef), sliced
ingredients.watch: Check the label: beef only. Some deli counters slice it beside prosciutto, so buy it sealed.

ingredients.name: Labneh (strained yogurt)
ingredients.watch: Check the label for gelatin. Or strain plain Greek yogurt overnight to make your own.

ingredients.name: Ready-cut chicken breast, plain (chunks or stir-fry strips)
Hard taco shells
ingredients.watch: Check the label: some taco shells are fried in lard. Most brands use vegetable oil.

ingredients.name: Whole quail
ingredients.watch: Most stores sell quail frozen, four to a pack. Thaw them in the fridge overnight.

ingredients.name: Whole red snapper, scaled and gutted
ingredients.watch: Ask the fish counter to scale and gut it. Check the label says red snapper: some fish sold as snapper is another kind.

ingredients.name: Tart baking apples (Granny Smith or Honeycrisp)
Frozen chicken or vegetable potstickers
ingredients.watch: Check the filling on the label: chicken or vegetables only. Many potstickers hold pork or shrimp; skip those.

ingredients.name: Cooked long-grain or basmati rice (microwave pouch)
